decisions.rationale: The profile reports row_count 13014 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so no exact duplicate rows exist in bronze and no dedupe is applied.

One hourly observation per station: 3 distinct origins times 4341 distinct time_hour values closely matches the 13014 rows, and both columns have null_rate 0.0, so (origin, time_hour) is declared as the grain pending warehouse measurement.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta are flagged is_airbyte_metadata true and carry no business meaning, so all three are dropped.
Every sampled time_hour value is ISO-8601 UTC text, so the column is cast strictly to TIMESTAMP; any non-ISO value would surface as a cast failure for review.

year, month, day, hour, and wind_dir landed as DECIMAL(38,9) but every profiled value is integral (e.g. month distinct values 1.0 through 6.0, wind_dir multiples of 10 from 0.0 to 360.0), so they are cast losslessly to INTEGER.
wind_gust has null_rate 0.745505 (9702 nulls of 13014 rows); the column is retained as nullable DOUBLE rather than imputed or dropped.
wind_dir (null_rate 0.016828), wind_speed (0.000154), and pressure (0.114953) have nonzero null rates; nulls are retained and no rows are excluded.

purpose: silver_nyc_weather is the cleaned hourly weather observation table for the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) in the first half of 2013, derived from bronze.nyc_weather. It provides typed, snake_case weather readings at the station-hour grain for joining to flight and operations tables.
usage: Read one row per (origin, time_hour), where time_hour is a proper UTC TIMESTAMP. Numeric readings are typed as DOUBLE and calendar parts as INTEGER. Consumers must handle nulls deliberately: wind_gust is null on about 74.6% of rows, pressure on about 11.5%, and wind_dir and wind_speed occasionally; no imputation was performed.
limitations: The cleanup retains all sparse columns rather than imputing: wind_gust (null_rate 0.745505), pressure (0.114953), wind_dir (0.016828), and wind_speed (0.000154) carry nulls through to silver. The wind_speed max of 1048.36058 is a likely sensor or unit outlier that was not filtered. The declared (origin, time_hour) grain was inferred from distinct counts (3 origins x 4341 hours vs 13014 rows) and must be confirmed against the warehouse before approval; data covers only January through June 2013.
